attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The restricted PrefixStableQrepTransparentSupport proof is theorem-shaped; the unresolved extension remains RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb for hidden full semantic SAT pruning and branch selection.
steps: Define K_PQ^0 as the final LB_N line plus its parsed bit-explicit parents. Iterate: add EF dependencies, SATeq certificate rows, bounded-SR_h leaves, reachable FormulaEval support rows, all counterfactual TSR children, and for each Qrep representative use add the lower-rank same-theory certificate forest and its row dependencies.

Prove termination by the finite proof DAG size plus a strict lexicographic measure: proof-line index, dictionary append time, and rank. Prefix stability forbids cycles and rebinding, so the fixed point is order-independent.

For each proof line l, maintain invariant I(l): all rows semantically influencing l through transparent rules are in K_PQ restricted to prefix l, and the circuit transcript for l has size at most the accumulated Gamma_PQ charge plus generator overhead already charged.

EF and SATeq cases reuse the prior Gamma_bEF parser; bounded-SR_h contributes B_SR<=N^{q+eta+tau+o(1)}; FormulaEval contributes U(K)+X(K); counterfactual TSR contributes N^{1+kappa+theta+o(1)} for complete child declarations.

Qrep case: replacing r_old by representative r_new is sound because the certificate C_e is same-theory, lower-rank, and already parsed into the prefix closure. The row deletion saves duplicate expansion only after D_Q(pi) has charged the dictionary entry and certificate forest.
At the final LB_N line, compose the generator circuit, parsed transcript circuit, and equality patches for E_pi exceptional rows to obtain C(H_N)<=N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_PQ(pi)+O(E_pi N).

If this upper bound is below N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}, it is a same-model falsifier for LB_N(1+epsilon). This proves only failure of that proof certificate or lower-bound assertion in the restricted parser model.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: It proves a parser/falsifier boundary for a restricted proof-system interface. It does not prove any H_N lower bound, does not construct a hard SAT carrier, and does not imply P != NP.

branch_outputs.branch_title: Hardness-Magnification Bridge Realization: prefix-stable Qrep support closure

assumptions: Model: nonuniform Boolean circuits for H_N and for the simulated generator; proof syntax is finite, bit-explicit, and verifier-visible.
Length regime: N tends to infinity, M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, L=(log N)^d for fixed d>1, and beta=0 so SAT circuit substitution contributes only N^{o(1)} after generator overhead.
Exponent regime: rho<1+epsilon and Gamma_PQ(pi)+O(E_pi N)<N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} are the intended falsifier thresholds.
Uniformity/advice status: the dictionary order, ranks, representatives, and same-theory certificates are in the proof transcript, not selected by nonuniform advice outside pi.
Same-theory condition: Qrep compression may identify rows only through surfaced EqSAT/TSR same-theory certificates whose dependencies are already in K_PQ(pi).
Barrier status: the theorem is relativizing as a parser/countermodel statement and deliberately does not claim a nonrelativizing RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb for full semantic pruning.
definitions: source object: H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)) with M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)}, polylog SAT instance length L=(log N)^d, and a Psys_bEF^- plus transparent FormulaEval/CTSR/Qrep proof pi of a source lower-bound line LB_N(1+epsilon).

target object: a nonuniform SIZE upper-bound circuit for H_N^SAT of size N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_PQ(pi)+O(E_pi N), used only as a route-level falsifier of the asserted source lower bound, not as a proof of P != NP.

controlled interface: visible row support, prefix-closed FormulaEval dependencies, counterfactual TSR child declarations, and append-only ranked Qrep dictionary entries whose same-theory certificates are dependency-closed and charged before representative use.

target-preserving condition: the simulation stays in the same nonuniform SIZE model, has beta=0 polylog target-query length, uses no hidden SAT-truth advice, and treats every semantic row influence as charged support unless a named RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb is supplied.

K_PQ(pi) is the least fixed point generated from the final LB_N line by adding parsed EF dependencies, SATeq links, bounded-SR leaves, reachable FormulaEval rows, counterfactual TSR child rows, and lower-rank dictionary-certificate rows needed by each Qrep representative use.

A dictionary entry e=(r_old,r_new,C_e,a_e) is prefix-stable iff it is appended before its first use, never rebound, has rank a_e below every later dependent quotient use, and its certificate C_e is parsed into K_PQ(pi) before deleting r_old from the charged row set.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Reject the lemma if any representative is used before its certificate is appended, if a rank cycle exists, if a later line rebinds a representative, if the merge certificate is semantic and uncharged, or if the row choice depends on advice not present in pi.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This is a proof-delivery upgrade for the TransparentRowSupport_N theorem pair: Qrep quotient compression becomes a checked rule case rather than an informal Gamma reduction.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For beta-zero parity carrier proofs whose FormulaEval/CTSR quotient compression is implemented by an append-only ranked same-theory dictionary, the least prefix-stable Qrep support closure K_PQ(pi) is a valid TransparentRowSupport_N rule case. The parser line induction gives a same-model upper-bound falsifier for any claimed LB_N(1+epsilon) whenever the charged transcript is subthreshold. The first pre-use, rebinding, rank-cycle, advice-chosen representative, or hidden semantic merge gives a private-row/unread-enable-bit countermodel.

assumptions: The proof verifier only reads the declared prefix and cannot query the private row except through the rejected Qrep action.
The target carrier parity depends on the hidden row through at least one reachable support path from the final LB_N line.
The same-theory certificate is absent, cyclic, too late, or not charged in Gamma before use.
definitions: Bad action types are pre-use deletion, representative rebinding, nondecreasing rank dependency, cyclic certificate dependency, advice-chosen merge, and hidden semantic same-theory assertion.
The countermodel keeps the charged prefix fixed and flips a private SAT label or unread enable bit on the first uncharged row whose value is needed by the quotient merge.
The conflict target is extensional safety of the parser, not the truth of SAT or the P vs NP conjecture.

equations.label: prefix_agreement
equations.valid_when: Valid for the earliest bad Qrep action after fixing all earlier charged rows and verifier-visible transcript fields.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: The countermodel fails only if a real-sat semantic certificate determines the hidden row and is uniformly listed with its full support charge before the quotient use.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Necessity side of the theorem pair; it shows why prefix-stable proof-carrying quotient compression is not optional.
candidate_lemmas.statement: If a Qrep dictionary violates prefix stability at the earliest bad action, then two oracle-style row worlds agree on all previously charged rows and proof-visible bits but disagree on the hidden representative row, so the parsed transcript cannot be a valid occurrence-completion certificate.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot only if a concrete semantic FormulaEval rule produces a charged influence realizer, or if a prefix-stable Qrep certificate can be shown insufficient by a non-private-row counterexample.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote as a restricted theorem after checking the finite verifier: append-before-use, no rebinding, strict rank decrease, dependency closure, same-theory parser, and Gamma charge before deletion.
control_decision.reason: The cycle discharges a supporting sublemma for the TransparentRowSupport_N theorem pair and Formula Footprints dictionary patch, while the full semantic SAT influence route remains blocked at the named RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb lemma.

falsifiers: falsifier: a Qrep representative used before its proof-carrying dictionary certificate is appended invalidates the charged parser and yields a private-row two-world countermodel.
falsifier: representative rebinding lets two prefixes share the same visible transcript while later quotient meaning changes, so Gamma_PQ is not valid.
falsifier: a rank cycle in same-theory certificates destroys the least fixed point and blocks line induction.
falsifier: advice-chosen dictionary compression hides semantic row selection and is outside TransparentRowSupport_N.
falsifier: full semantic branch pruning without RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb remains quarantined, even if the restricted Qrep ledger is valid.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: At Delta=0 the closure charges the certificate before deleting r0 and line induction is valid. At Delta>0 a private-row world can flip r0 while preserving all charged prefix information, making the quotient deletion unsound.
held_fixed_controls: M_N=N^{q+o(1)} with q<1+epsilon and beta=0 polylog SAT instance length.
Same final LB_N line and same visible proof syntax before the first quotient use.
No nonuniform SAT-truth advice outside the transcript pi.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch needs to test whether prefix-stable Qrep is genuinely necessary for the theorem pair or merely a cosmetic ledger condition.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: A beta-zero parity carrier H_N^SAT with two quotient-equivalent-looking CTSR child rows r0,r1; the proof deletes r0 using a Qrep dictionary entry whose same-theory certificate is either appended before use or delayed until after the final LB_N line.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A finite verifier certificate that every Qrep use references an append-only dictionary entry whose rank decreases, whose same-theory proof forest is already in K_PQ, and whose row expansion cost is included in Gamma_PQ before the use.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: dictionary delay Delta, the number of proof steps between first representative use and the surfaced same-theory certificate; Delta=0 is prefix-stable and Delta>0 is pre-use compression.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 152 upgrades Qrep from an append-only convention to a prefix-verifiable rule case: quotient compression preserves the transparent parser only when certificate charge strictly precedes representative use. The exact no-go is temporal, not just acyclicity; delayed same-theory evidence is already a private-row falsifier. This closes a proof-audit loophole while preserving the nonclaim boundary: no H_N lower bound and no P != NP result.
